text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL). The combination of fatigue and weight loss with the peripheral smear finding of "smudge cells" is pathognomonic for CLL; these fragile cells are a hallmark of this condition due to their nuclear membrane instability. I do not require further testing to confirm this clinical picture.
